name: quiz_grading
held_out: Enumerated from the answer forms a learner can plausibly type — a 0-based index, a letter, the option's own text, the wrong option, nothing at all — plus the open-question path. Written against what grading *should* do, not against grade_quiz()'s branches.
conventions: Indices are 0-based, matching QuizQuestion.answer_index. A free-form answer that does not match exactly is reported as ungraded (null), never guessed wrong.
